claims.text: The sentiment share in the window after patch release dropped to 33.53%.
Negative reviews mentioning content increased by 4.50 points in the window compared to the baseline.
Negative reviews mentioning monetization increased by 5.84 points in the window compared to the baseline.
Reviewers frequently expressed dissatisfaction with the high pricing of expansions relative to the base game.
Players criticized the release of costly downloadable content while core performance issues remained unaddressed.

report.summary: The sentiment share in the window after patch release dropped to 33.53%. Negative reviews mentioning content increased by 4.50 points in the window compared to the baseline, and negative reviews mentioning monetization increased by 5.84 points in the window compared to the baseline. Reviewers frequently expressed dissatisfaction with the high pricing of expansions relative to the base game, and players criticized the release of costly downloadable content while core performance issues remained unaddressed. The patch, a price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
